peter.birthplace.label: Bethsaida

benedict-xi.saint.public_note: Sources disagree on the year his cult was confirmed (1736 or 1773).
benedict-xi._why: Year conflict: Catholic Encyclopedia 1773 vs uncited 1736. Independent fact review 2026-10-10: feast is the day of his death, 7 July (roster end 7.VII.1304). Cult-confirmation year still kept as disputed.
